description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'CommonCommand' which provides a base implementation for common commands within the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes fields and methods related to command type, category, headers, and resource path, and ensures immutability. The class serves as a foundation for specific command implementations.

classes.name: CommonCommand
classes.description: An abstract class that serves as the base for all common command implementations within the Eclipse Ditto signals commands, providing shared functionality and immutability.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Returns the category of the command.

methods.name: getTypePrefix
methods.description: Provides the type prefix used for command identification.

methods.name: getResourceType
methods.description: Returns the resource type associated with this command, fixed as 'common'.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns an empty JsonPointer indicating the resource path.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Determines equality based on class, super equality, and category.

methods.name: canEqual
methods.description: Checks whether another object can be considered equal to this.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes the hash code based on super hash and category.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation including superclass info and category.
